articles.title: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization (ATSE:HTO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher On Split Analyst Revisions
articles.summary: The fair value estimate for Hellenic Telecommunications Organization has shifted slightly, moving from €20.58 to €21.26 per share. This sits within a broader analyst range of €18 to €23.80, which reflects the mix of more optimistic views on the stock’s potential and more cautious takes around execution risks and sector headwinds. As you read on, you will see how this updated price target fits into the evolving narrative around Hellenic Telecommunications Organization and what it could mean...
